challenges.name: Garden Pest Patrol
challenges.description: Start your totem's journey by protecting the garden. Use your instinct and reflexes to smack down those pesky moles.

challenges.name: Boulder Breaker
challenges.description: Break a massive rock by timing your strikes correctly. Strength determines power and speed.

challenges.name: Totem Wrestling
challenges.description: Push against a guardian spirit in a strength duel. Tap rapidly to overpower it.

challenges.name: Rockfall Defense
challenges.description: Block falling boulders by clicking in the right zones. Strength increases stamina.

challenges.name: Spirit Path Navigation
challenges.description: Navigate a magical path of vanishing tiles, racing from start to finish.

challenges.name: Aerial Ring Dive
challenges.description: Fly through shifting rings in the air. Agility improves control.

challenges.name: Totem Spirit Dance
challenges.description: Tap in rhythm with spirit drum beats. Agility determines timing accuracy.

challenges.name: Ancient Runes Decoding
challenges.description: Memorize and repeat glowing rune patterns. Wisdom increases memory retention.

challenges.name: Celestial Star Mapping
challenges.description: Connect stars to form constellations. Wisdom provides hints and reduces errors.

challenges.name: Spirit Weaving Runes
challenges.description: Align magical runes in the correct order. Wisdom slows instability.
